Pricing in 2026: Cheapest Choice for Frequent Releases

CD Baby uses one-time fees and charges $9.99 per single and $14.99 per album with no recurring payments. Bedroom producers dropping quarterly EPs usually save with DistroKid. Four EPs through CD Baby cost $59.96, while DistroKid stays at $24.99 for the year.Apr 21, 2026
